evidence.quote: The Bachelor's degree course in Mechatronics is designed as a full-time course with a duration of 7 semesters, starting in the summer semester (beginning of March).
The language of instruction is English.
All students who do not come from the EU pay tuition fees of 1,500 euros for each semester.
The following tuition fees apply for applicants from: non-EU countries 1,500 EUR
Depending on the degree program, applicants must first register at hochschulstart.de (German-speaking study programs) or can apply directly through our RWU Portal (English-speaking study programs).

notes: Tuition: the RWU pages state a non-EU tuition of 1,500 EUR per semester (both the DAAD record and the RWU international financing page). The generic RWU 'Financing and Hedging' page also mentions this for all non-EU students; period is 'semester', so amountMinor is 150000 per semester. The general application page (https://www.rwu.de/en/application-and-enrollment) gives an English-taught Bachelor application window 01.09.2025 - 15.11.2025 (summer semester 2026), but the programme page gives 01. September - 31. October, and the international study-offer page lists Mechatronics as 'summer 2027 intake' with an application period 1 September - 31 October; dates conflict across pages. The values were entered with the year 2026 (applicationOpens/Deadline), which is the concrete year shown in the study-offer/application pages. Grade thresholds: the page names TOEFL/IELTS scores and aptitude-test scores (TestAS, SAT, ACT) but these are entrance-test/aptitude scores, not a secondary-school grade threshold, so they are captured as language_proficiency or manual_check. Only documents named in the programme page's postal-application list are listed; documents listed on other RWU pages (e.g. study orientation test, Tätigkeitsnachweis) are not included because those pages are not this programme's own page. The 'translationRequired' flag was set to true for the university entrance certificate and transcripts because the programme page requires them 'in English or German' (university entrance certificate) / 'Certified copies' (transcripts).

note.fr: Candidats hors UE : 8 % des places de chaque programme sont réservées aux étudiants non-UE. Votre certificat d'accès à l'université doit être conforme à ANABIN ; sinon un examen d'aptitude (TestAS, SAT, ACT, etc.) peut être exigé. Vérifiez votre cas auprès de l'Admissions Office (application@rwu.de).
note.en: Non-EU applicants: 8% of study places in each degree program are reserved for non-EU students. Your university entrance certificate must be ANABIN-compliant; otherwise an aptitude test (TestAS, SAT, ACT, etc.) may be required. Check your case with the Admissions Office (application@rwu.de).

evidence.quote: At our university, 8% of the study places in each degree program are reserved for students from non-EU countries.
Is your UEQ recognized here in Germany? Check on Anabin.

note.fr: Des compétences mathématiques très bonnes et de bonnes connaissances dans d'autres matières scientifiques (physique, informatique) sont attendues. Ce n'est pas un seuil de note chiffré : à vérifier manuellement.
note.en: Very good mathematical skills and good knowledge of other science subjects (physics, computer science, etc.) are expected. This is not a numeric grade threshold: to be checked manually.

evidence.quote: Very good mathematical skills and good knowledge of other science subjects (physics, computer science, etc.).
